text: I think you'll enjoy this Tomato and Basil Sauce recipe, given your fondness for soy sauce and sesame oil. Although it doesn't feature either of these ingredients, the flavors of the fresh basil and olive oil might appeal to you. The dish also includes chicken breast, which is a staple in many of your liked recipes. The cooking time is a bit longer than usual, but it's within your typical range. Overall, this recipe seems like a good fit for your tastes and cooking habits.
